purpose: Outcome-free local-CPU cost audit of a cross-policy alignment Hessian-vector product relative to an ordinary owner actor gradient.
scientific_exclusions: no claim about a specific MARL framework implementation

measurement.baseline: forward all actors, form the same smooth centralized interaction surrogate, and differentiate once with respect to owner parameters
measurement.alignment_hvp: the baseline with create_graph plus one reverse derivative of the owner-gradient alignment scalar with respect to all eligible donor blocks
measurement.timing_order: deterministic alternation of baseline-first and HVP-first repetitions
measurement.memory: parameter and tensor sizes only; process RSS is not accepted as a peak-autograd-memory measurement

mandatory_gates.C1: all timings and derivative norms are finite and strictly positive
mandatory_gates.C2: every donor block has a nonzero cross-policy alignment derivative
mandatory_gates.C3: median across-configuration HVP-to-baseline time ratio is at most 4.0
mandatory_gates.C4: maximum configuration HVP-to-baseline time ratio is at most 6.0
mandatory_gates.C5: within each agents/width/batch cell, degree-4 HVP median time is at most 1.35 times degree-2 when both degrees are distinct
mandatory_gates.C6: a clean same-machine rerun reproduces every configuration median within 15 percent; only authorized after C1-C5 pass

stopping_rule: Any failure among C1-C5 stops clean reproduction and any claim that the estimator has acceptable low-complexity overhead. Thresholds, grid, repetition counts, and seeds may not change after the primary run.
